description: This Java source file defines the AppendToNoteActivity class, an Android activity that allows appending shared text to an existing note within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles UI setup, retrieves shared text, and updates notes accordingly.

classes.name: AppendToNoteActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that enables appending shared text to an existing note, extending MainActivity, with UI handling and note updating logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, extracts shared text, sets toolbar title, and updates UI subtitle.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a note, appends shared text to the note content, updates the note, and provides user feedback.
